items.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
items.raw_excerpt: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

title_i18n.en: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
title_i18n.zh: 随着人工智能安全担忧加剧，三位先驱主张保持开放。
title_i18n.es: Mientras aumentan las preocupaciones por la seguridad de la IA, tres pioneros defienden la apertura.

excerpt_i18n.en: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

items.title: 与运行时无关的 AI 工作流：一种兼顾生产环境稳定性和快速评估迭代的模式
items.raw_excerpt: AI 工作流是一系列为完成某项任务而串联起来的步骤，其中一个或多个步骤包含对 大语言模型（LLM） 的调用。在此，我们将这些步骤组合在一起的逻辑（包括步骤的顺序和分支）称为工作流的协调逻辑。

title_i18n.zh: 与运行时无关的 AI 工作流：一种兼顾生产环境稳定性和快速评估迭代的模式
title_i18n.en: Runtime-agnostic AI workflows: a model that balances production stability with rapid evaluation iteration.
title_i18n.es: Flujo de trabajo de IA independiente del tiempo de ejecución: un patrón que equilibra la estabilidad en producción con la iteración rápida de evaluación.

excerpt_i18n.zh: AI 工作流是一系列为完成某项任务而串联起来的步骤，其中一个或多个步骤包含对 大语言模型（LLM） 的调用。在此，我们将这些步骤组合在一起的逻辑（包括步骤的顺序和分支）称为工作流的协调逻辑。
excerpt_i18n.en: An AI workflow is a series of interconnected steps designed to complete a task, where one or more steps involve calls to a large language model (LLM). Here, we refer to the logic that combines these steps—including their order and branching—as the workflow's coordination logic.
excerpt_i18n.es: Un flujo de trabajo de IA es una serie de pasos encadenados para completar una tarea, en la que uno o más pasos incluyen llamadas a un modelo de lenguaje grande (LLM). Aquí, la lógica que agrupa estos pasos (incluido el orden y las ramificaciones de los pasos) se denomina lógica de orquestación del flujo de trabajo.

items.title: 智象未来 (HiDream.ai)算法科学家潘滢炜博士确认出席AICon深圳，将分享“从 Token 预测到状态预测：迈向世界模型的原生全模态之路”
items.raw_excerpt: 大模型能力持续演进，但 AI 的下一阶段竞争正在发生变化。模型能力之外，如何构建可靠的智能体、完善 AI 工程体系，并让 AI 在复杂业务环境中稳定运行，正在成为产业探索的新重点。

title_i18n.en: Dr. Pan Yingwei, Algorithm Scientist at HiDream.ai, has confirmed attendance at AICon Shenzhen, where he will share insights on "From Token Prediction to State Prediction: The Road to Native Omni-Modal World Models."
title_i18n.es: El Dr. Pan Yingwei, científico de algoritmos de HiDream.ai (Zhixiang Weilai), ha confirmado su asistencia a AICon Shenzhen, donde compartirá «De la predicción de tokens a la predicción de estados: el camino hacia un modelo mundial nativo multimodal».

excerpt_i18n.zh: 大模型能力持续演进，但 AI 的下一阶段竞争正在发生变化。模型能力之外，如何构建可靠的智能体、完善 AI 工程体系，并让 AI 在复杂业务环境中稳定运行，正在成为产业探索的新重点。
excerpt_i18n.en: Large model capabilities continue to evolve, but the next stage of AI competition is shifting. Beyond model capabilities, how to build reliable agents, improve AI engineering systems, and ensure stable AI operation in complex business environments is becoming a new focus of industry exploration.
excerpt_i18n.es: Las capacidades de los grandes modelos siguen evolucionando, pero la competencia en la próxima fase de la IA está cambiando. items.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
items.raw_excerpt: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion funding round into River AI, a two-month-old AI startup, highlighting intense investor interest in early-stage AI companies.

title_i18n.en: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
title_i18n.zh: General Catalyst 领投11亿美元融资轮，投资仅成立两个月的River AI。
title_i18n.es: General Catalyst lidera una ronda de 1.100 millones de dólares en River AI, de apenas dos meses de vida.

excerpt_i18n.en: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion funding round into River AI, a two-month-old AI startup, highlighting intense investor interest in early-stage AI companies.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 成立仅两个月的AI初创公司River AI获得了由General Catalyst领投的11亿美元融资，这一巨额投资显示出资本市场对新兴AI技术的高度关注。本轮融资的具体用途和公司技术方向尚未披露，但预计将加速其产品研发与团队扩张。

items.title: Apple in Talks to Pay Publishers for News Content to Power Siri AI
items.raw_excerpt: Apple is reportedly in talks with publishers to license news content for its Siri AI, aiming to enhance the timeliness and accuracy of AI-generated answers. This reflects Apple's push to secure premium content sources in the competitive AI race.

title_i18n.en: Apple in Talks to Pay Publishers for News Content to Power Siri AI
title_i18n.zh: 苹果洽谈向出版商付费，以获取新闻内容支持Siri AI
title_i18n.es: Apple está en conversaciones para pagar a editores por contenido de noticias para potenciar la IA de Siri.

excerpt_i18n.en: Apple is reportedly in talks with publishers to license news content for its Siri AI, aiming to enhance the timeliness and accuracy of AI-generated answers. This reflects Apple's push to secure premium content sources in the competitive AI race.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 据报道，苹果公司正与多家出版商洽谈，计划为其Siri AI功能支付新闻内容授权费用，以提升人工智能生成回答的时效性和准确性。此举显示苹果正积极寻求高质量内容源，以在AI竞赛中缩短与竞争对手的差距。
